verdict: The reported behavior was reproduced; no candidate repair was evaluated.
inputReport:
Gaps in Linkding's current protection against server-side requests to internal addresses (latest commit, with the 2ffc8bb fix in place)

Muse Spark reviewed the current protection against the two confirmed expectations and proposed five missed ones. The owner confirmed one on October 31: even when the server is configured to use an HTTP proxy, checking a bookmark URL that points at an internal address does not make the server request that address. Linkding's own source already lists this as a known limitation.

expectations.statement: When the server is configured to reach the internet through an HTTP proxy, checking an ordinary public bookmark URL still fetches it through that proxy.

limitations: No independently qualified decoy challenges or held-out evaluation performed.
Evidence applies only to the confirmed expectations, fixtures, and recorded runtime.
Local processes are not a hostile-code sandbox.
No independently correct controls supplied; false-rejection calibration is unavailable.
